query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
edited_by_user as "Edited by user",
user_email as "User email",
user_role as "User role",
to_char(((edited_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "Date and time edited"
from "reporting"."ds__patients_change_logs"
where
((edited_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and
((edited_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:patientId is null then true
else patient_id = 
:patientId
end
and
case
when 
:userId is null then true
else edited_by_user = 
:userId
end
order by edited_datetime
name: Audit - patient details edit
notes:
This report lists all of the users that have edited the selected patient's personal details for the selected date range and parameters. Specifically the report tracks edits to the patient 'Details' component where personally identifiable information is recorded such as name, date of birth, contact information and insurance details.
Edits are listed in chronological order. If multiple changes are made to an individual patient's details within a minute, these changes will be grouped together and displayed as a single edit in the report.
